name: function-overload-test-133208fdef/function-overloading-diff-arg-count-e.bal
spec_references: Module-level declarations: Function definition; Supports required-params, defaultable-params, included-record-param and rest-param in the signature

reason: The test asserts rejection of a second module-level function with the same name despite a different parameter count.
